title: 0x Gasless Trade Structure
description: Field-level documentation for the gasless trade lifecycle: quote → submit → status.

fields.name: tradeHash
fields.description: Unique hash identifying the gasless trade. Used to poll status via GET /gasless/status/{tradeHash}.

fields.name: chainId
fields.description: Chain on which the gasless trade settles.

fields.name: approval
fields.description: EIP-712 approval payload (Permit, Permit2, or ExecuteMetaTransaction). Required only when the taker has not pre-approved the Settler.

fields.name: eip712
fields.description: EIP-712 typed data the taker signs off-chain.

fields.name: trade
fields.description: The Permit2-based meta-transaction the taker signs and 0x relayers submit on-chain.

fields.name: fees
fields.description: Detailed fee breakdown — integratorFee, zeroExFee, gasFee.

fields.name: gasFee
fields.description: Gas fee deducted from the sell token to compensate the relayer.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle: pending → submitted → succeeded → confirmed | failed | expired.

fields.name: transactions
fields.description: On-chain transaction(s) emitted by the relayer for this trade.
